The '''ShadoWing-4''' was a civilian [[para-wing glider]] based on [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] gliders. Its wings allowed for superior mobility, and the on-board [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generator allowed for a flight ceiling of 5 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. However, the ShadoWing-4 was a fragile design and not recommended for use in hazardous weather. Safety features included a sensor beacon, navigational equipment and emergency thrusters.

[[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] often modified the ShadoWing for use by [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinders]] and [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]], by removing the beacon to avoid detection.
